notes.title: IdleTale's patch 0.5.0 is out now!
notes.content:
Version 0.5.0: Redemption

-Deadly Quests cost reduced by 50%.
-Added a new version of Ashtar Catacombs.
-The Heart of Darkness now reacts to the player's power.
-Added new Quests.
-IdleTale now has a Launcher! You can choose to launch the game through the Launcher or directly execute the game in Steam.
-Added the Redemption system.
-Added the first four Spirits.
-Added new Glory Upgrades.
-Added new Maps.
-Added new Gains Upgrades.
-Added new Upgrades.
-Added new Dungeons.

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a bug where the player could attack (though with no effect) during the Ascension cutscene.
-Fixed a bug where the developer was too slow releasing updates.

Planned features for patch 0.5.1:
-New Dungeons
-Bloodboil Depths
-Oni

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0 arrives May 15th
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.5.0: Redemption[/b]

-[b]Deadly Quests[/b] cost reduced by 50%.
-Added a new version of [b]Ashtar Catacombs[/b].
-The [b]Heart of Darkness[/b] now reacts to the player's power.
-Added new [b]Quests[/b].
-[b]IdleTale[/b] now has a [b]Launcher[/b]! You can choose to launch the game through the Launcher or directly execute the game in Steam.
-Added the [b]Redemption[/b] system.
-Added the first four [b]Spirits[/b].
-Added new [b]Glory Upgrades[/b].
-Added new [b]Maps[/b].
-Added new [b]Gains[/b] Upgrades.
-Added new [b]Upgrades[/b].

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a bug where the player could attack (though with no effect) during the [b]Ascension[/b] cutscene.
-Fixed a bug where the developer was too slow releasing updates.

Planned features for [b]patch 0.5.1[/b]:
-New [b]Dungeons[/b]
-[b]Bloodboil Depths[/b]
-[b]Oni[/b]

Notes:
-Yeah, we now have a launcher. Pretty useless, to be honest. But at least it's cool. It'll have some functions in the future like changing the screen size or maybe allowing for saving different games. Who knows.
-I'm still working in the server for IdleTale, that's part of the reason of why it's taking so damn long to get updates. I won't lie, there's many other things going on. But that's another one. And I'll try to have it ready as soon as possible.

notes.content:
-Deep within, the blood starts to boil...

notes.title: Patch 0.4.3
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.4.3[/b]

-Servo-Arm now always has a cooldown of 0.5 sec instead of 0.5-1 sec depending on the player's Attack Speed
-Halloween event!
-Added the Dungeon Hollow Thicket and its respective Deadly version
-Base Maximum Energy increased from 20 to 100
-Extra Energy now increases the player's maximum Energy by 10 instead of by 5
-Added keyboard shortcuts for the different UI panels
-Curret Raid waves decreased from 15/15/20 to 10/10/15
-Offline Glory rewards increased by 100%
-Map cost reduced from 5M to 2M
-True Idle is no longer a Talent. Instead, it is now an Upgrade whose cost is 5K

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a bug where Voideyes would grant incorrect buff values
-Fixed a bug where Mega Swarm could not appear among the possible Voideye buffs
-Fixed a visual bug where the offline time counter would show 0h after surpassing 24h offline (rewards were correct though)
-Fixed a bug where Outcast Jacket could not drop at certain Luck Levels
-Fixed a bug where the Achievement Unlocked pop-up would get stuck at the top of the screen (Windows only)
-Fixed a bug where the Collector's Regalia 2-set would affect Raids as well
-Fixed some bugs that would make achievements, texts and Voideyes go faster than intended in the Steam version
-Scroll speed increased when using the mouse wheel
-Fixed a bug where the offline rewards wouldn't add Gold if the game was closed before redeeming them
-Added an extra layer of protection to avoid data loss after a sudden shutdown
-Early Special items will now have 5x chance of dropping
-Added a Reset Dungeon option at the end of each Dungeon

Notes:
-It was not a good design to force players to spec into Berserking in the early stages of the game in order to receive offline rewards for killing mobs. This change also allows for an earlier acquisition of this feature, and some Berserking Talents can now be revamped.
-Some of these changes might come in earlier than 0.4.3
-Fixed a bug when changing maps while the Mega Swarm buff was active
